description: Defines the TemplateCurrency class for handling currency fields in SuiteCRM, extending TemplateRange, including methods for saving, deleting, and database type definition.

classes.name: TemplateCurrency
classes.description: Class for managing currency field templates, including size, precision, and database type specifications.

methods.name: delete
methods.description: Deletes the currency field and associated currency ID.

methods.name: save
methods.description: Saves the currency field and associated currency ID with proper formatting.

methods.name: get_field_def
methods.description: Returns the field definition array, including precision.

methods.name: get_db_type
methods.description: Returns the database column type string for the currency field.
